components.label: Description
components.quote: SHINGRIX (Zoster Vaccine Recombinant, Adjuvanted) is a sterile injectable suspension for intramuscular use that contains recombinant varicella zoster virus gE antigen adjuvanted with AS01B.

components.label: Description
components.quote: The gE antigen is obtained by culturing genetically engineered Chinese Hamster Ovary cells, which carry a truncated gE gene, in media containing amino acids, with no albumin, antibiotics, or animal-derived proteins.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Each 0.5-mL dose is formulated to contain 50 mcg of the recombinant gE antigen, 50 mcg of MPL, and 50 mcg of QS-21.

allergens.quote: The gE antigen is obtained by culturing genetically engineered Chinese Hamster Ovary cells, which carry a truncated gE gene, in media containing amino acids, with no albumin, antibiotics, or animal-derived proteins.
In the vial and vial presentation, the vial stoppers are not made with natural rubber latex.

related.quote: The AS01B adjuvant is composed of 3-O-desacyl-4’-monophosphoryl lipid A (MPL) derived from Salmonella minnesota and QS-21, a saponin purified from Quillaja saponaria Molina plant extract, and is combined in a liposomal
related.note: AS01B 佐劑為 MPL＋QS-21 脂質體，非鋁鹽；仿單未明文寫「不含鋁」，故列未載明並附佐劑組成原句（句子跨頁 16→17，quote 截至頁 16 末行）

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Do not administer SHINGRIX to anyone with a history of a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to any component of the vaccine or after a previous dose of SHINGRIX [see Description (11)].

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote: In the prefilled syringe presentation, the tip cap and rubber plunger stopper are not made with natural rubber latex.
